goal: Reconstruct the EDGE-GW latency timeline from the alert log and state exactly which conclusions the records support — and do not support — about any causal relationship between the maintenance drill and the latency degradation or recovery.
case_context: A seized NOC (network operations) laptop. The monitor directory holds the service latency alert log; the change directory holds the approved maintenance record; the mail directory holds the on-call handover note. Assess the records exactly as they are.

charter.text: Reconstruct the EDGE-GW latency timeline from the alert log, and assess exactly what the records establish — and do not establish — about any causal relationship between the maintenance drill and the latency degradation or recovery.
